alert.en: Crowd movement in busy places can be monitored, and alerts can be quickly sent.
alert.zh: 可以监视繁忙地点的密集人群移动，并迅速发送警报。

alert.en: Animations alert pedestrians but are not suitable for runners and cyclists, who are travelling too fast to react.
alert.zh: 动画可以提醒行人，但不适合移动太快而无法反应的跑步者和骑自行车的人。

alert.en: To alert somebody means to warn them about a potential danger.
alert.zh: 警惕某人意味着警告他们注意潜在的危险。

alert.en: The goal is to alert pilots when they've made a mistake and to diminish the consequences of mistakes.
alert.zh: 目标是在飞行员犯错时发出警报，并减轻错误带来的后果。

alert.en: Because if they don't know, then I need to be alert.
alert.zh: 因为如果他们不知道，那么我就需要警惕。

alongside.en: Its citizens fought alongside Britain in World War I and later World War II.
alongside.zh: 其公民与英国并肩作战，参加了第一次世界大战和后来的第二次世界大战。

alongside.en: The Ottomans were in retreat. Lawrence rode into the city alongside Faisal’s men.
alongside.zh: 奥斯曼人正在撤退。Lawrence 与 Prince Faisal 的部下一起骑马进入了城市。

alongside.en: This was alongside works of Aristotle, the great Greek physician Galen, and more.
alongside.zh: 这与亚里士多德、伟大的希腊医师盖伦等人的著作一起出现。

alongside.en: And what did the new day-trippers want at the seaside, alongside sand and ice cream?
alongside.zh: 而除了沙滩和冰淇淋，新的日游游客在海滨想要什么呢？

alongside.en: So this meant there were now large English-speaking communities living alongside French-speaking Canadians.
alongside.zh: 这意味着，如今有大量说英语的社群与说法语的加拿大人生活在同一片土地上。

alternative.en: A country that depends on just one industry or one resource has very few alternatives.
alternative.zh: 一个依赖单一产业或单一资源的国家几乎没有其他选择。

alternative.en: Anyone who fell outside those categories still had no alternative to the workhouse.
alternative.zh: 任何落入这些类别之外的人仍然没有替代济贫院的选择。

alternative.en: But the alternative is running out of power to sell their own products.
alternative.zh: 如果不这样做，他们就会面临没有电力来销售自己产品的境地。

alternative.en: Because usually like that, and what's interesting is like, you can define commitment by eliminating alternatives.
alternative.zh: 因为通常像那样，有趣的是，你可以通过排除其他选项来定义承诺。

alternative.en: The city became known for its alternative culture and its vibrant nightlife.
alternative.zh: 这座城市以其另类文化和充满活力的夜生活而闻名。

alter.en: If you tweak something, you alter it slightly in order to improve it.
alter.zh: 如果你 tweak（微调）某物，你就会对其进行轻微的改动以便改进它。

alter.en: Machu Picchu remained hidden in the mountain for centuries while most other Incan cities were destroyed or heavily altered.
alter.zh: 马丘比丘在山中隐藏了几个世纪，而大多数其他印加城市则被摧毁或严重改变。

alter.en: The process of developing a reading brain alters everything, from brain activity to brain structure and brain connectivity.
alter.zh: 开发阅读大脑的过程改变了一切，从大脑活动到大脑结构和大脑连接。

alter.en: The arrival of Europeans was the start of enormous changes that would, I guess, reshape or completely alter the land and the people of the land forever.
alter.zh: 欧洲人的到来，开启了巨大的变革，我猜，这些变革将永远重塑或彻底改变这片土地及其人民。

alphabet.en: And so, in 1928, he ordered the complete switch to the Latin alphabet.
alphabet.zh: 因此，在1928年，他下令全面转向拉丁字母。

alphabet.en: The Japanese kanji alphabet is based off the Chinese alphabet, at least the historic version of it.
alphabet.zh: 日语的汉字字母是基于汉字演变而来的，至少历史版本是这样的。

alphabet.en: The Japanese kanji alphabet is based off the Chinese alphabet, at least the historic version of it.
alphabet.zh: 日语的汉字字母是基于汉字演变而来的，至少历史版本是这样的。

alphabet.en: Chinese characters, for example, use symbols instead of letters of the alphabet to represent words and ideas.
alphabet.zh: 例如，汉字使用符号而不是字母表中的字母来代表单词和想法。

alien.en: One Earth Day is equivalent to 4 days 5,100 seconds in the alien system.
alien.zh: 一个地球日相当于外星系统里的4天又5100秒。

alien.en: They have to find a common time. One minute is 25 seconds in the Aliens time system.
alien.zh: 他们必须找到一个共同的时间标准。在外星人的时间系统里，一分钟只有25秒。

alien.en: I agree, I think that maybe life does exist beyond our planet, but maybe not as we see in alien movies.
alien.zh: 我同意，我认为生命可能存在于我们的星球之外，但也许不像我们在外星人电影中看到的那样。

allegation.en: It was also during this time that allegations of corruption began to follow him.
allegation.zh: 也正是在这段时间里，有关腐败的指控开始缠上他。

allegation.en: There have even been allegations of politicians paying for the support of influencers in places like Colombia, Argentina and Indonesia.
allegation.zh: 甚至有指控称，在哥伦比亚、阿根廷和印度尼西亚等地，政治家花钱收买网红的支持。

ally.en: Throughout the Cold War, the West had seen him as a reliable anti-communist ally.
ally.zh: 在整个冷战期间，西方一直视他为可靠的反共盟友。

ally.en: For Mubarak and his cronies, his family and his allies, life was good, very good.
ally.zh: 对于 Mubarak 及其亲信、他的家人和盟友来说，生活很美好，非常美好。

ally.en: Hannibal’s initial hope, that Rome’s allies would rise up and join him, had largely not transpired.
ally.zh: Hannibal最初的希望——即罗马的同盟会起义加入他——大部分并没有实现。

ally.en: They cut off the city from many of its allies and trade routes.
ally.zh: 他们切断了该市与其许多盟友和贸易路线的联系。

ally.en: The Allies include the USA, the UK, France, and the Soviet Union.
ally.zh: 盟军包括美国、英国、法国和苏联。

alternate.en: Jean-Philippe Laborde, director of rice company, Tilda, thinks the answer lies in a new growing technique called Alternate Wet Drying, or AWD for short.
alternate.zh: 大米公司 Tilda 的总监 Jean-Philippe Laborde 认为，答案在于一种名为“间歇灌溉”（Alternate Wet Drying，简称 AWD）的新种植技术。

alternate.en: So what exactly is code switching? Code switching is when a speaker alternates between two or more languages or even different varieties of the same language within a single conversation, sentence or interaction.
alternate.zh: 那么，究竟什么是语码转换？语码转换是指说话者在同一段对话、一句话或互动中，在两种或多种语言、甚至同一种语言的不同变体之间进行交替使用。

allege.en: It would later be alleged that Stonehouse had been spying for Czechoslovakia since the late 1960s.
allege.zh: 后来有人指控 Stonehouse 从 60 年代末就开始为捷克斯洛伐克当间谍。

allege.en: A lawsuit was filed on February 3rd, alleging that DOGE’s access to the Treasury’s systems violated federal privacy laws.
allege.zh: 2 月 3 日提起了一起诉讼，指控 DOGE 访问财政部系统的行为违反了联邦隐私法。

allege.en: The newspaper report alleged that the inmates were so hungry that they were fighting over the bones before they ground them.
allege.zh: 报纸报道称，院民们饿得在骨头研磨之前就开始争抢它们。

allege.en: It’s a story of suspicion, the devil, witchcraft– alleged witchcraft, I should add–mass hysteria, hints of psychedelic drugs, and justice.
allege.zh: 这是一个充满猜疑、恶魔、巫术——我得补充一下，是所谓的巫术——群体歇斯底里、迷幻药痕迹以及正义的故事。

allege.en: Now, I should add that these killings didn’t take place; it seemed that he'd been scammed, but the prosecution alleged that the intent was there.
allege.zh: 在这里我应该补充一下，这些谋杀并没有实际发生，他似乎是被骗了，但检方指控他确实有此意图。

alive.en: He says, “I deem him one of the greatest beings alive in our time.
alive.zh: 他说：“我认为他是我们这个时代最伟大的生命之一。

alive.en: The aim was to make borrowing cheap, encourage spending, and keep economies alive.
alive.zh: 这样做的目的是降低借贷成本，鼓励消费，并维持经济运转。

alive.en: So part of it is just the doomerism meme is always alive and well, right?
alive.zh: 所以部分原因只是末日论模因总是活着并且很好，对吧？

alive.en: But in maths class he came alive. Numbers somehow made sense when people did not.
alive.zh: 但在数学课上，他整个人都生动了起来。当人们让人难以理解时，数字不知怎么地总是讲得通。

alive.en: But, despite all of these problems, the American Dream is still alive according to lots of people.
alive.zh: 但是，尽管存在所有这些问题，在许多人看来，美国梦依然活着。

allegiance.en: She was a Conservative, both by political allegiance and in her fiscal beliefs.
allegiance.zh: 无论在政治归属还是财政理念上，她都是一名保守派。

allegiance.en: The tension was about money and power and political allegiance.
allegiance.zh: 这种紧张关系的根源在于金钱、权力和政治立场。

allegiance.en: Ariely says fraternities and sororities work like this — when they make rushers stand in the rain or run naked across campus, turning indignity into allegiance.
allegiance.zh: Ariely 说兄弟会和姐妹会就是这样运作的——当他们让新成员站在雨中或赤身裸体跑过校园时，就把羞辱转化为了效忠。

allegiance.en: This was an era of nationalist movements, and, perfectly reasonably you might argue, these groups wanted a country to call their own, they didn’t want to just be subsumed, swallowed up, by an empire to which they didn’t feel a strong sense of allegiance.
allegiance.zh: 这是一个民族主义运动的时代，而且你完全可以合情合理地认为，这些群体想要一个属于他们自己的国家，他们不想被一个他们没有强烈效忠感的帝国所吞并。

allegiance.en: Before we get into exactly what he did, let me tell you a little about his early life, as this also helps you get a taste for quite how multi-ethnic the region was, how over the years its various towns and cities have switched allegiances, and even names.
allegiance.zh: 在我们深入探讨他具体做了什么之前，让我先向你介绍一下他的早年生活，因为这也有助于你体会该地区是多么地具有多民族性，多年来其各个城镇是如何改变阵营甚至名字的。

alliance.en: Some had been defeated in battle and forced into uneasy alliances.
alliance.zh: 其中一些在战斗中被击败，被迫结成了勉强的同盟。

alliance.en: His strategy relied on breaking Rome’s alliances, encouraging these Italian communities to join him and rise up against the Republic.
alliance.zh: 他的战略依赖于瓦解罗马的同盟，鼓励这些意大利社区加入他并奋起反抗共和国。

alliance.en: He came to put down a Catholic alliance and to punish those responsible for violence against Protestant settlers eight years earlier.
alliance.zh: 他来是为了镇压天主教联盟，并惩罚那些在八年前对新教定居者实施暴力的人。

alliance.en: Alliances formed, tensions rose over time, and eventually a single event on a specific day pushed countries into open conflict.
alliance.zh: 同盟形成，紧张局势随时间加剧，最终特定一天的一个单一事件将各国推向公开冲突。

alliance.en: Cortés used this to his advantage. As he marched towards the capital, he made alliances with the enemies of the Aztecs.
alliance.zh: 科尔特斯利用了这一点来为自己谋利。当他向首都进军时，他与阿兹特克人的敌人结成了同盟。

allied.en: Then there were the Gauls, the recently conquered or allied tribes from southern France.
allied.zh: 还有高卢人，也就是刚刚被征服或归附的法国南部部落。

allied.en: During World War II, Berlin was a major target for Allied bombing.
allied.zh: 第二次世界大战期间，柏林是盟军轰炸的主要目标。

allied.en: The Sultan was powerless. Allied forces occupied Istanbul.
allied.zh: 苏丹无权无势。盟军占领了伊斯坦布尔。

allied.en: The victorious Allied powers, the United States, the United Kingdom, France, and the Soviet Union, divided Germany into different occupation centers.
allied.zh: 胜利的盟军——美国、英国、法国和苏联——将德国划分成不同的占领区。

allied.en: And if that wasn’t bad enough, its enemies—the victorious Allied powers of Britain, France, and Italy—were now circling like vultures.
allied.zh: 如果这还不够糟糕的话，它的敌人——胜利的盟军英国、法国和意大利——现在正像秃鹰一样盘旋。

alike.en: For hundreds of years, it had been one of the most powerful empires in the world, feared by European kings and emperors alike.
alike.zh: 数百年来，它一直是世界上最强大的帝国之一，令欧洲国王和皇帝闻风丧胆。

alignment.en: By the 16th century, the calendar had drifted out of alignment with the seasons once again.
alignment.zh: 到了 16 世纪，日历再次与季节失去了同步。

alignment.en: So if you look around and you see that people are stuck in region beta, this zone of comfortable complacency, right it's the guy that sticks in his just okay job because his boss isn't too much of a dick but the pay isn't that good and he's not really that passionate but it's all right whatever whatever the person that stays in the acceptable relationship they're not that fired up but they're not really in love and their partner's not really got much alignment with their interests or the person that stays in a crappy apartment and there's a bit of mold in the ceiling but it's cheap and it's in a good area of town or whatever all of these people would be better off if their situations were worse because it would give them the activation energy to kick them out of the bottom and that only regret would be not doing it sooner dude i love that when i see it's funny because if i look back on the instances that were the most painful in my life every single one of them without fail has created a disproportionate gain right like the most painful thing early on was for me was quitting my job and leaving, you know, leaving my dad, basically.
alignment.zh: 所以如果你环顾四周，就会发现人们陷入了贝塔区域，也就是那种舒适的自满区，对吧？就像那种死守着一份马马虎虎的工作的人，因为老板不算太混蛋，但工资也没那么高，他其实也没什么热情，不过也就将就了，随便怎样都行；或者是那种维持着一段食之无味、弃之可惜的亲密关系的人，他们对彼此没有多少激情，也没有坠入爱河，伴侣和他们的兴趣也根本不在一个频道上；或者是一个住在破旧公寓里的人，天花板上甚至有点霉菌，但房租便宜，而且地段在城里还算不错，诸如此类。所有这些人，如果他们的处境能再糟糕一点，其实反而对他们更好，因为那能给他们提供激活能量，把他们从谷底踢出去，而他们唯一的遗憾就是没有早点这么做。老兄，我太喜欢这个观点了。说来也搞笑，如果我回想自己人生中最痛苦的那些时刻，每一个无一例外都带来了不成比例的巨大收获，对吧？比如我早期经历的最痛苦的事，就是辞职并离开，你知道的，基本上就是离开我父亲。

allocate.en: It's how entrepreneurs allocate their talent.
allocate.zh: 那就是企业家如何分配自己的才能。

allocate.en: Dogs, cats and rats were killed to supplement the miserable 125 grammes of bread a day that each resident was allocated.
allocate.zh: 狗、猫和老鼠都被杀来吃，以勉强维持每人每天仅有125克面包的可怜配给。

allocate.en: So the question is just, can you keep the thugs with the guns paid and happy and successful society where you're allocating based on merit?
allocate.zh: 所以问题仅仅在于，你能不能让拿着枪的暴徒得到报酬、感到满意，并建立一个基于功绩分配的成功社会？

allocate.en: Entrepreneurs are responsible, inventors are responsible, farsighted government bureaucrats allocating budgets to unlikely projects are responsible, consumers who are willing to try something, adapt to something, are responsible.
allocate.zh: 是企业家的功劳，是发明家的功劳，是那些有远见、愿意把预算投向看似不靠谱项目的政府官员的功劳，也是那些愿意尝试新事物、愿意去适应新事物的消费者的功劳。

allocate.en: The happier you are, the more you can sustain doing something The more likely you're going to do something that will in turn make you even happier And you'll continue to do it and you'll outwork everybody else The more free you are, the better you can allocate your time And the less you're caught up in a web of obligations and commitments And the more you can focus on the task at hand This is related to another insight of yours the less you want something, the less you're thinking about it, the less you're obsessing over it, the more you're going to do it in a natural way.
allocate.zh: 你越快乐，你就越能持续地做某事。你越有可能做一些反过来让你更快乐的事情。你会继续做下去，你会比任何人都努力。你越自由，你就越能分配你的时间。你越少陷入义务和承诺的网中，你就越能专注于手头的任务。这与你的另一个见解有关：你越不想要某样东西，你对它的想法就越少，你对它的执念就越少，你就越会以自然的方式去做它。

altitude.en: This is a high altitude basin surrounded by mountains and lakes.
altitude.zh: 这是一个被群山和湖泊环绕的高海拔盆地。

altitude.en: A high altitude basin is a large, flat area of land that is surrounded by mountains and is located high above the sea level.
altitude.zh: 高海拔盆地是指一块周围环绕着山脉、且位于海平面较高位置的大片平坦土地。

album.en: He goes, he goes, find me, you know, whatever, eight more albums.
album.zh: 他说，去给我找，你知道的，再找八张专辑来。

album.en: I like it when an album like stands alone outside of an artist's career as a defining moment in time.
album.zh: 这可能是因为它以不同的方式录制，或者所有的歌都是关于特定的事情，或者他们使用了与以往不同的乐器。

album.en: This is how public figures can have normal everyday people on Twitter say unspeakable, like heinous things to them, dehumanizing things because they do not see them as human. they don't see them as a person there is no person on the other side of this there is it's they're a representation they're a menagerie of of of ideas therefore i can say whatever i want to them because they're not they're not really a person but they are and the fact that before there is any status associated with tearing you down no one is incentivized to tear you down and you haven't changed fuck dude the lewis capaldi documentary i've watched this twice now no lewis capaldi is the singer scottish singer amazing dude really fascinating story suffering a lot with mental health makes this first album and billions billions of streams world tour phenomenal and he's playing songs that he wrote in 2017 and played in working men's pubs around scotland the same songs go to number one so not just that he's become better he's the same guy.
album.zh: 这就是为什么公众人物在Twitter上会被普通人说出难以启齿的、令人发指的话，非人化的东西，因为他们不把他们看作人。他们不把他们看作一个人，对面没有一个人，他们只是一个代表，一个思想的集合体，所以我可以对他们说任何我想说的话，因为他们不是真正的人。但他们确实是人。事实上，在撕下你的标签带来任何地位之前，没有人有动力去撕下你，而你并没有改变。该死，Lewis Capaldi的纪录片，我已经看了两遍了。Lewis Capaldi是那位歌手，苏格兰歌手，很棒的家伙，非常迷人的故事，深受心理健康困扰，制作了第一张专辑，数十亿次的播放量，世界巡演，现象级。他唱的歌是他2017年写的，在苏格兰的工人酒吧里唱的。同样的歌变成了冠军单曲。所以不仅仅是他变得更好了，他还是同一个人。

alleviate.en: But at least just being aware of why your stress can help alleviate a lot of stress. and then anxiety i think is sort of this pervasive unidentifiable stress where you're just kind of stressed out all the time and you're not even sure why and you can't even identify the underlying problem and the reason for that is because you you have so many uh unresolved problems unresolved stress points that are piled up in your life that you can no longer identify what the problems are and there's this mountain of garbage in your mind and it's a little bit of a Thank you. poking out the top like an iceberg and that's anxiety but underneath there's a lot of unresolved things and so you just need to kind of go through very carefully every time you're anxious like okay why am i anxious this time i don't know why oh well let me sit here and just think about it let me write down what the possible causes could be let me meditate on it let me journal let me talk to a therapist let me talk to my friends let me just kind of see like when does that stress go away.
alleviate.zh: 但至少意识到为什么会感到压力，可以帮助减轻很多压力。至于焦虑，我认为这是一种普遍的、无法识别的压力，你整天都感到压力很大，甚至不知道为什么，甚至无法识别潜在的问题。原因在于，你生活中堆积了太多未解决的问题、未解决的压力点，以至于你无法再识别出问题到底是什么。你的头脑里有一座垃圾山，只有一点点像冰山一样露在顶端，那就是焦虑，但在下面有很多未解决的事情。所以你需要非常仔细地梳理，每次感到焦虑时，就想：“好吧，这次我为什么焦虑？我不知道为什么。”哦，好吧，让我坐在这里思考一下，让我写下可能的原因，让我冥想，让我写日记，让我和治疗师谈谈，让我和朋友谈谈，让我看看这种压力什么时候消失。
